dedupe_keys.name: wastewater treatment unit processes datasets pollutant removal efficiencies evaluation criteria and cost estimations fhnw

description: This dataset gives typical pollutant removal efficiencies for 11 parameters, evaluation criteria and cost estimates for 37 common wastewater treatment unit processes, based on literature research, expert workshops and estimations. It was produced at the University of Applied Sciences and Arts Northwestern Switzerland (FHNW) and is available as a free download from Zenodo as an Excel database with three PDF tables, under a CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 licence (version 1.0.0, December 2018). Coverage is generic, not tied to any country or plant. Caveats: the values are typical ranges and expert estimates, not measurements at specific plants, the costs date from 2018, and the licence forbids commercial use and derivatives. Simulation uses: parameterising treatment trains in capacity planning and in optimisation of treatment and reuse options. Related records: California treatment plant unit processes (data-california-wwtp-unit-processes-permits-cwns) and the European UWWTD treatment plant data (data-uwwtd-treatment-plants).
